name: Kusumi Ritsuko
source:
The [url=https://vndb.org/c62499]protagonist[/url]'s aunt.
After Touya was taken in by his grandparents due to the death of both his parents she took charge in raising him.

She is always nagging and meddling in Touya's business, she realizes herself though that she is a bit too obsessed with him and things can't continue the way they are.
